recentUpdates.note: Contract 2026-10-18.1: invoices are version 3 and name their alg (secp256k1-eip712 or ml-dsa-65) beside the signature; v1/v2 bodies are accepted until 2026-11-15 and the reply says deprecated. A payee binds an ML-DSA-65 key once with POST /api/level1/key-binding; from then on only that key bills (a v1, v2 or secp256k1 invoice is refused with sig_alg_missing). New codes: sig_alg_missing, sig_alg_unknown.

Contract 2026-10-17.1: every agent reply carries ok and contractVersion; a refusal is one error object with code, by, executed, audience, meaning, nextStep, retryAfterSecs and words (the old sentence). The codes are served at GET /api/level1/codes.
A paid-API purchase refused after its signature reached the seller says executed: yes or unknown from the chain; never resend it then.
